description: While a modal dialog is open in OpenTune, ui.setWorkspace is refused like every write: BUSY(modal_open), executed false, and the window keeps the workspace it showed (PROTOCOL.md section 13.2). The given opens a message dialog, which a runner cannot make in a running OpenTune window; the vector is checked against the mock and a window-less test build only, and a runner without that precondition skips it.
